parameters.text:
=You are an expert AI Job Matcher specializing in generating high-precision search queries for the Tavily Search Engine.

Task: Analyze the candidate's CV below to generate EXACTLY ONE search query following this structure: "{seniority} {role} {stack}"

Candidate CV:
{{ $json.cv ? JSON.stringify($json.cv) : $json.output }}


Rules for Parameter Extraction & Formatting:
- seniority: Map from CV years of experience to exactly one of [junior, ssr]. NEVER output senior or staff: the candidate only wants roles asking for 3 to 4 years of experience at most.
- role: Map to one of [full stack, backend, frontend].
- stack: Extract exactly 2 core technologies present in the CV, prioritizing the ones mentioned most frequently. Do NOT invent technologies.

Rules for Output:
- Combine the extracted values strictly into the template: "{seniority} {role} engineer {stack}".
- Output ONLY the raw search query string. No preambles, no markdown code blocks, no explanations, no quotes around the output.

=You have attached the CV of the user:

## User CV
{{ $json.text }}
## end of user CV

Mision:
1. Convert this text in a JSON format for an LLM to understand it flawlessly.
2. Extract experience, seniority, tech stack, links, side projects and user title.


The output must be in this format:
{
  "name": "",
  "title": "",
  "contact": {
    "phone": "",
    "email": "",
    "linkedin": "",
    "website": ""
  },
  "summary": "",
  "experience": [
    {
      "company": "",
      "role": "",
      "start_date": "",
      "end_date": "",
      "responsibilities": [],
      "technologies": [],
      "client": ""
    }
  ],
  "side_projects": [
    {
      "name": "",
      "url": "",
      "description": "",
      "highlights": [],
      "technologies": []
    }
  ],
  "skills": {
    "frontend": [],
    "backend": [],
    "databases": [],
    "cloud_infra": [],
    "other": []
  },
  "years_of_experience": 0
}
